column1: # Hades II (Supergiant Games' engine on NVN, SDK 19.3.9), base game v0 (the NACP's display version 0.0.126424).
# Started from the NSP script's provisional profile; values marked "Mario's" are not measured for this game yet.
# Unlike Hades (Vulkan), the Switch version renders with NVN: its 88 shaders are BNSH files in Shaders/NVN/bin (.vert / .frag; the .shader files list each program's pair).
# The ExeFS has only main and sdk. main's EOS_* imports (Epic Online Services, from nro/EOSSDK-Switch-Shipping.nro, loaded through nn::ro) stay offline: the host
# registers no NRR, so the game never loads the NRO.
# the right stick aims (the weapons with ManualAiming in Game/Weapons/PlayerWeapons.sjson)
# Exact line replacements baked into the RomFS image at build time (the wide-screen Lua fix in romfs_patch.tsv:
# RunLogic's X/Y lookups become the phone's 2344x1080 literals, the HUD's absolute anchors move 40 out)
# The baked RunLogic frame literals are one phone's frame (2344x1080): on another screen the engine lays its
# UI out for a wider frame than it renders -- an iPad mini (1640x1080) got its HUD lifted and its margins
# pushed out. Serve the two literals per device instead (the image is never touched, so its identity
# stands): the width digits (offset 0x1782a in the baked Scripts/RunLogic.lua) become the mode's render
# width as ASCII, the height digits (0x17846) the mode's frame height -- 1080 docked, 0720 handheld (a Lua
# decimal literal; the leading zero is not octal). Patterns are the digits' little-endian words.
# With the fullscreen setting on, nn::oe reports 2344x1080 docked (the phone's 19.5:9 at docked height):
# the engine renders the wide picture itself instead of the present stretching a 1920x1080 one
# The launcher offers the frame-rate choice (SS_DISPLAY_HZ): the front end drives the present, the present link and the
# vi vsync event at the rate it measures on the screen, and falls back to 60 when the screen cannot hold 120 (hle_nvn.c).
# Whether this engine follows past 60 is unmeasured (it has no hle_fpslock row for its build yet): an experiment, 2026-10-27.
# The NPDM declares no system resource (META +0x14 = 0): the game uses SetHeapSize. It asks for 3.10 GB (pool − used memory), which the 3.25 GB heap region of
# the 4 GB layout holds. main carries an 82 MB bss: the rewritten modules take more than the default 64 MB of used memory, so SetHeapSize(pool − 64 MB) would not fit
